tests.name: signed in, 31 Tier B routes (Health, Wallet, AI, Settings, Calendar, Intents, Sharing): ?spotlight=1 at 1280 and 1440 px renders [data-archetype] equal to the route's manifest archetype, the sidebar chrome (search, nav items, footer) is intact, no DelayedLoader and no page-level spinner after the screen settled, dashboards show exactly one spotlight card in the first viewport, no horizontal scroll in LTR and RTL; ?spotlight=0 renders no [data-archetype]

flag off = legacy tree (no [data-archetype], default header, in-content SplitBar); flag on = ScreenFrame with the manifest archetype, compact header, tabs in the utility row, standard VCards, empty states instead of sample content; Vitana Index hero = exactly one spotlight VCard with real data only and a spotlight skeleton while loading; every migrated page composes ScreenFrame behind useSpotlightEnabled(); manifest test; flag-off regressions (Calendar golden screen, Connected Apps health cards, Wallet Rewards on a phone, Settings > Notifications) with the flag pinned off; share-button guard
tests.reason: The flag-on/flag-off render and the per-page source contract are deterministic in jsdom; staging proves the frame, chrome and layout on the deployed build without writing anything.
